class.name: FluidSynthPlayer
class.brief_description: A node that synthesizes and plays audio using FluidSynth with SoundFont instruments and MIDI control.
class.description:
FluidSynthPlayer integrates the FluidSynth software synthesizer with Godot's audio system. It loads SoundFonts, generates stereo audio, and streams the generated samples through an AudioStreamGenerator.
The node can use an existing AudioStreamPlayer, AudioStreamPlayer2D, or AudioStreamPlayer3D specified by its audio_player property. If no audio player path is specified, it creates and manages its own AudioStreamPlayer child.
Audio rendering is performed automatically during processing. The render_audio() method can also be called explicitly to fill the available audio buffer.
SoundFonts can be loaded from SoundFont resources, and their available presets can be retrieved for instrument selection. MIDI messages can be sent individually through dedicated methods or processed from InputEventMIDI events.
Volume, gain, polyphony, and reverb can be configured at runtime. Chorus configuration is WIP.

method.name: render_audio
method.description: Renders stereo audio samples using FluidSynth and pushes them into the audio playback buffer. The method does nothing if the synthesizer or audio playback is unavailable, or if no frames are available. Rendering is limited to 2048 frames per call.

method.name: load_sound_font
method.description:
Loads a SoundFont resource into the FluidSynth synthesizer and returns its assigned SoundFont ID. If a SoundFont was previously loaded through this method, it is unloaded after the new SoundFont loads successfully.
Returns -1 if the synthesizer is unavailable, the resource is null, or loading fails.

method.name: get_sound_font_presets
method.description:
Returns an array of SoundFontPreset resources describing the presets available in the currently loaded SoundFont. Each preset contains its bank number, program number, and name.
Returns an empty array if no SoundFont is loaded or the synthesizer cannot access the loaded SoundFont.

method.name: note_on
method.description: Starts playing a note on the specified MIDI channel. The channel is clamped to 0-15, and the key and velocity are clamped to 0-127. A velocity of 0 follows the underlying FluidSynth note-on behavior; use note_off() or handle_midi_event() to explicitly handle note release.

method.name: note_off
method.description: Sends a note-off event for the specified key on the specified MIDI channel. The channel is clamped to 0-15 and the key to 0-127.

method.name: program_change
method.description: Selects the instrument preset for the specified MIDI channel by setting its bank and program. The channel is clamped to 0-15, the bank is clamped to a minimum of 0, and the program is clamped to 0-127.

method.name: control_change
method.description: Sends a MIDI control change message to the specified channel. The channel, controller number, and controller value are clamped to 0-15, 0-127, and 0-127, respectively.

method.name: key_pressure
method.description: Sends polyphonic key pressure, also known as aftertouch, for a specific key on a MIDI channel. The channel, key, and pressure are clamped to their supported MIDI ranges of 0-15, 0-127, and 0-127, respectively.

method.name: channel_pressure
method.description: Sends channel pressure, also known as channel aftertouch, to the specified MIDI channel. The channel is clamped to 0-15 and the pressure to 0-127.

method.name: pitch_bend
method.description: Sends a MIDI pitch bend message to the specified channel. The channel is clamped to 0-15 and the pitch bend value to 0-16383.

method.name: all_notes_off
method.description: Sends an all-notes-off controller message (MIDI controller 123) to the specified channel. This requests the synthesizer to release all currently playing notes on that channel. The channel is clamped to 0-15.

method.name: all_sounds_off
method.description: Sends an all-sounds-off controller message (MIDI controller 120) to the specified channel, immediately silencing its active sounds. The channel is clamped to 0-15.

method.name: reset_controllers
method.description: Sends a reset-all-controllers message (MIDI controller 121) to the specified channel, restoring its MIDI controller settings to their default values. The channel is clamped to 0-15.

method.name: handle_midi_event
method.description:
Processes an InputEventMIDI event and forwards supported MIDI messages to the FluidSynth synthesizer.
Handles note-on, note-off, polyphonic key pressure, control change, program change, channel pressure, pitch bend, system reset, and stop messages. A note-on event with zero velocity is treated as a note-off event. A system reset silences all channels and resets their controllers, while a stop message silences all channels.
Messages intended for sequencing or MIDI synchronization, including start, continue, timing clock, and system-exclusive messages, are ignored. Null events are also ignored.
